name: cal-02-date10
version_tag: CALENDAR (shiura thing:7035937 Ver.2) — tens-of-date drum + white numeral inlay, Month-Date-Day English variant, FULL SIZE. PROOF PLATE: chosen as the first physical print deliberately — it exercises the identical two-colour mechanics as the month drum (z_offset registration, purge tower, black/white AMS mapping) on the shortest base in the set, so a registration or bleed failure costs ~2h and ~45g instead of 6h10m and 128g. What is being proven is the z_offset: it is nonzero on every drum, it is the value that ruins the part if wrong, and the slice preview cannot show whether the inlay actually seats flush in its recess — only that the arithmetic is consistent. REGISTRATION: compose centres each object on its own bbox and drops each to the bed, so both pairings are restored by hand. Measured from original STL coords: bbox-centre delta letter-minus-base [+0.001, 0.000] (i.e. concentric, unlike the day drum's -1.161), base min-z -11.10 vs letter min-z -9.47 gives z_offset 1.630. Expect the two-colour band to start near layer 8 (1.63/0.2) and run ~40 layers; if it starts at layer 0 the offset was silently dropped. SPEEDS: stock 0.20mm Standard, NOT the quiet override block from the Oechslin gear plates. FILAMENT: slot 1 black PLA MATTE, slot 2 white PLA BASIC — the AMS white is Basic, not Matte, and find_ams_slot only checks the FIRST filament, so read the ams_mapping in the start payload by eye before confirming.
